Metadata.title: Bazar
Metadata.description: Sell online from your phone. Turn your Facebook and WhatsApp orders into a real shop.

Home.tagline: Your shop, online, from your phone.
Home.intro: Bazar turns your Facebook and WhatsApp messages into a real shop that customers can find and order from.
Home.comingSoon: Coming soon. We are building it now.

Validation.slugFormat: Use 3–40 small letters, numbers or dashes (no spaces).
Validation.slugReserved: This link is reserved. Try another one.
Validation.slugTaken: This link is already taken. Try another one.
Validation.phoneFormat: Enter a Mauritius mobile number, e.g. 5123 4567.
Validation.codeFormat: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.
Validation.codeWrong: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the email or ask for a new code.
Validation.tooManyRequests: Too many tries. Please wait a minute and try again.
Validation.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Validation.imageType: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
Validation.imageSize: The image must be smaller than 2 MB.
Validation.uploadFailed: The image could not be uploaded. Try again.

Auth.title: Sign in to Bazar
Auth.subtitle: Sell from your phone. No password needed: we email you a code.
Auth.spamHint: No email after a minute? Look in your spam folder.

Dashboard.pendingHelp: We will check your shop soon. Until then, it shows as “Unverified”.
